_note: PrimeTurf turf range. Specs come from the PT product cards. `band` is the indicative installed R/m² range the estimator starts from (site prep is added, and the total is clamped to site.json pricing). `look` picks the colour style used to paint the concept visual. Set `published: true` on an item to also build its /turf/{id}/ page. CALIBRATE `band` against real quotes.
